commands.review_summary:
The branch makes Control UI Nostr profile imports abortable, locked drafts while removing server-side import merging and persistence.

PR surface: Source -25, Tests +116. Total +91 across 9 files.

Reproducibility: yes. from source and focused tests: current main permits a pending import to perform server-side persistence, while the UI lifecycle can be canceled or replaced before the response completes. A real relay reproduction was not performed.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] The contributor must preserve the shipped endpoint contract and supply real-environment Nostr proof; automation cannot provide evidence from their external relay setup.

target.title: fix(nostr): keep profile imports as cancellable drafts
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Nostr profile imports could mutate config before the user reviewed the relay data. To reproduce, edit a profile, click **Import from Relays**, change a field while the request is pending, then let the response complete: the imported value can overwrite the same-field edit. Click **Cancel** while the request is pending: the form closes, but the server-side merge can still persist.

## Why This Change Was Made

The import endpoint now returns relay data as a draft and never writes profile config. The Control UI requests `autoMerge: false`, locks profile controls while the import is pending, and owns an `AbortController` for the request. Cancel, disconnect, and form replacement abort and invalidate the operation, so a late response cannot update a hidden or newer form. Explicit **Save & Publish** remains the write path.

The first PR CI run exposed a type-only regression in the new test: `check-test-types` failed at `ui/src/pages/channels/channels-page.test.ts` because Vitest inferred zero-argument `mock.calls` tuples. The test now captures `RequestInit` inside a typed `vi.fn<typeof fetch>` callback instead of indexing that tuple.

## User Impact

Imported values fill the open form for review. Users can edit them and explicitly publish, while Cancel cannot hide a mutation that already persisted and stale responses cannot replace a newer form.

## Evidence

- `corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` — passed; pinned Playwright Chromium dependencies were installed with `node scripts/ensure-playwright-chromium.mjs`.
- CI run `29216318218` identified the failure: `check-test-types` / job `86712898354`, with the UI check and all other completed checks passing.
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs` passed for the three CI test-type projects: `tsconfig.core.test.json`, `tsconfig.extensions.test.json`, and `tsconfig.test.root.json`.
- `OPENCLAW_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/nostr/src/nostr-profile-import.test.ts extensions/nostr/src/nostr-profile-http.test.ts ui/src/pages/channels/channels-page.test.ts ui/src/pages/channels/view.test.ts` — passed: 4 files, 40 tests.
- `OPENCLAW_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.ui-e2e.config.ts --configLoader runner ui/src/e2e/nostr-profile-import.e2e.test.ts` — passed: 1 Playwright test.
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check`, type-aware `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --threads=1` over all 9 changed files, and `git diff --check` — passed.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local` — clean after the CI fix; the full branch autoreview was also clean before the CI-only correction.
- Remote proof was unavailable for this fork patch: sanitized AWS Crabbox warmup failed before lease creation with `no EC2 IMDS role found`; the local Crabbox config has no broker token. Credential-hydrated Testbox was not used for fork code.

## Limitations

The new CI run is pending on head `501ccd9a4142896dcbe1cccb2822c0ef4d31a992`. No live Nostr relay was used; relay import behavior is covered through the deterministic test seam. Remote Testbox/Crabbox proof remains blocked by the credential boundary above.
